item.title: Three Slides for Slow Sundays

turns.text: Make 3 square Instagram carousel slides that look like a set for a cosy café. Text, in order: 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', 'Stay a little longer'. Warm cream and coffee-brown colours, simple illustrations. Give me the three separate slides, ready to post.

item.tests: Tests delivery of three individually usable carousel slides with correct ordered copy and a cohesive visual system.

answer_sheet.Slide count and delivery: Three separate image files, in the requested order; not one combined strip.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
answer_sheet.Exact wording: Slide 1: Slow Sunday. Slide 2: Coffee first. Slide 3: Stay a little longer.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Cosy café mood, warm cream and coffee-brown palette, simple illustrations, coordinated typography and layout.

must_haves: There are exactly three separate square slides, not a contact sheet.
The slides read, in order, 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', and 'Stay a little longer'.
All three use a recognizably shared cream-and-coffee-brown palette and typography.
Each slide includes simple café-related illustration rather than only plain text.
All wording is readable and fully inside the slide boundaries.

I couldn’t generate the slides because Magic Hour refused all three requests due to **insufficient credits**. No images were created.

Once credits are available, I can make the three separate square slides as a matching cream-and-coffee-brown set:
1. **Slow Sunday** — coffee and croissant
2. **Coffee first** — steaming mug
3. **Stay a little longer** — cosy café table and chair

style.prompt: Create ONE square Instagram carousel slide, the first in a coordinated cosy café set. Flat minimalist editorial illustration, solid warm cream background (#F6EBDD), coffee-brown ink (#51392D), restrained latte-tan accents (#C49A75). Generous negative space, polished balanced layout with broad safe margins. Large beautifully legible coffee-brown classic serif headline centered in the upper half. The ONLY text, spelled exactly, is: "Slow Sunday". Below the headline, a simple charming hand-drawn illustration of a steaming coffee cup and saucer beside a small croissant, using clean coffee-brown lines and flat tan fills. Small understated brown four-point sparkle accents. Warm, calm, inviting independent café aesthetic. No gradients, no photography, no logo, no watermark, no additional text, no slide numbers. Fill the entire square canvas; this is one standalone finished slide, not a collage or mockup.
